svg.title: Total conversation savings
svg.desc: The saving of one Claude Code session on Opus 5.5 against the price without DensePack, with Ponytail 5, with DensePack 2.0.2, and with DensePack 2.0.2 on an Opus 5.5 main agent and a Sonnet 5.5 subagent. Five files read, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $0.98. Five files read, Ponytail 5, Opus 5.5: $0.98, 0.6% less. Five files read, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.51, 48.3% less. Five files read, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.28, 71.2% less. Architecture doc, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $0.74. Architecture doc, Ponytail 5, Opus 5.5: $0.56, 24.9% less. Architecture doc, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.35, 52.8% less. Architecture doc, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.41, 43.9% less. Read-in-full architecture, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $1.81. Read-in-full architecture, Ponytail 5, Opus 5.5: $1.58, 12.8% less. Read-in-full architecture, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $0.87, 52.1% less. Read-in-full architecture, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $0.56, 69.3% less. Code trace, Baseline, Opus 5.5: $4.74. Code trace, Ponytail 5, Opus 5.5: $4.26, 10.0% less. Code trace, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5: $2.36, 50.2% less. Code trace, DensePack 2.0.2, Opus 5.5 main + Sonnet 5.5 Subagent: $1.48, 68.8% less.
